summary: Model updated for the NEWLEADER/UPTODATE change and validated on 6 fresh traces. Model checking found three counterexamples. Each was reproduced on the update revision and on the old baseline, so the update narrows but does not close the NEWLEADER-ACK durability gap.
validation_limits: All model-checking campaigns are budget-limited (planned stop, non-empty queue, depth 13-29 or sampled simulation); no exhaustive or unbounded claim.
Finite bounds: 3 servers, 1 txn, MaxEpoch 2-3, at most 2 crashes, 3 role exits, 1 drop, 1 snapshot; observers and reconfiguration excluded.
Leader propose/commit are not instrumented; the trace spec infers them through gated observation steps.
TRUNC sync and late-joiner commits before NEWLEADER (SyncCommitApplied) were not observed in fresh traces.
The MC-1 reproduction emulates a crash before fsync by making a stalled txn-log append fail, then restarting the process from disk.
The MC-3 reproduction drives the real learner with a scripted leader that sends LearnerHandler's TRUNC(0) decision.
The specular CLI is not installed, so ci-result reports were not generated.

findings.title: NEWLEADER ACK is sent before the logged sync proposals are durable
findings.cause: Learner.syncWithLeader hands buffered DIFF proposals to the asynchronous SyncRequestProcessor (logRequest) and immediately ACKs NEWLEADER; the leader serves its history on a NEWLEADER-ACK quorum.
findings.trigger: Old leader holds an uncommitted txn; learners DIFF-sync it and ACK NEWLEADER; the leader serves it; the learners crash before their txn-log write and restart while the old leader is unreachable; they elect a new leader.
findings.consequence: A txn that clients read at the old leader is missing at the new leader (lost acknowledged data).

premises: The NEWLEADER ACK is written without waiting for the SyncRequestProcessor flush of the requests logged at NEWLEADER.
The leader starts serving after a NEWLEADER-ACK quorum.

findings.title: Learner failing between NEWLEADER and UPTODATE keeps a stale DataTree; in-process re-election loses the served txn
findings.cause: startupWithoutServing leaves the learner instance in INITIAL; on failure before UPTODATE, LearnerZooKeeperServer/ZooKeeperServer.shutdown return early (canShutdown), so the DataTree is not fast-forwarded from the log, while votes and Leader.lead use the DataTree position.
findings.trigger: Learners ACK NEWLEADER after a DIFF sync, the leader serves the synced txn, the learners' UPTODATE read fails, the old leader becomes unreachable, and the learners re-elect without restarting their processes.
findings.consequence: The new leader serves a history without the txn clients already read; the txn remains in the learners' logs and resurfaces after a restart (replica divergence).

premises: A learner instance between NEWLEADER and UPTODATE is not RUNNING and its shutdown is skipped.
FLE votes and Leader.lead use the in-memory DataTree position.

findings.title: TRUNC to a zxid absent from the learner log keeps the next entry
findings.cause: FileTxnLog.truncate keeps entries through the first entry with zxid >= target; LearnerHandler sends TRUNC(0) when an empty leader syncs a learner that holds an uncommitted txn.
findings.trigger: A learner with an uncommitted txn joins a newly elected leader whose committed log is empty.
findings.consequence: The learner reloads the uncommitted txn into its DataTree (lastProcessedZxid 0) and serves data no leader committed.

premises: An empty committed log makes syncFollower send TRUNC with lastProcessedZxid 0.

findings.title: Per-txn ACKs from processors started at NEWLEADER can precede the NEWLEADER ACK
findings.cause: Request processors now start at NEWLEADER, so SendAckRequestProcessor may write ACK(zxid) before the NEWLEADER ACK. LearnerHandler reads the first ACK as the NEWLEADER ACK, and Leader.waitForNewLeaderAck ignores a mismatched zxid.
findings.trigger: The SyncThread flushes a DIFF proposal and its ACK reaches the socket before the learner thread writes ACK(newLeaderZxid).
findings.consequence: The leader may not count that learner toward its NEWLEADER quorum and may time out and re-elect (availability only).
